# Project Decisions — ai musical chair

Structured decision memory (spec §50–52). The source of truth is `.agylite/decisions.yaml`; record decisions with
`agylite decide add --kind <architecture|security|design|…> --topic … --decision … --reason …`.
The table below is regenerated between the markers; edit text outside them freely.

<!-- agylite:decisions:start -->
| ID | Date | Kind | Topic | Decision | Reason | Supersedes | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| D-001 | 2026-10-16 | architecture | hosting | Next.js 15 App Router on Vercel + Supabase cloud (Postgres, Auth, Realtime); no local services | Every player connects from their own phone over the internet; free tiers; built-in realtime and RLS | — | ACTIVE |
| D-002 | 2026-10-16 | architecture | game-logic-location | All game state transitions and grading run in Postgres security-definer RPCs; clients only call RPCs and subscribe to realtime | Single source of truth, atomic chair claims under concurrency, answers never reach clients | — | ACTIVE |
| D-003 | 2026-10-16 | architecture | surfaces | One deployment with three routes: /admin, /play, /screen (projector = another Chrome tab) | Shared types and auth, one deploy; user confirmed projector is just a tab | — | ACTIVE |
| D-004 | 2026-10-16 | security | answer-secrecy | questions.answer and attempts.is_correct are never readable by player or screen roles; grading is server-side with server timestamps | Players must not learn correctness or answers; prevents client-side tampering of times | — | ACTIVE |
| D-005 | 2026-10-16 | security | chair-qr | Chair QR encodes chair id + random secret; claim accepted only for an authenticated active player during scan_open phase, once per spin per chair and per player | Stops unregistered scans, photo-of-QR scans before music stops, and double claims | — | ACTIVE |
| D-006 | 2026-10-16 | security | anti-cheat | Browser-level deterrence only: fullscreen, no select/copy/context menu, name watermark, visibility/blur/pagehide alerts to admin; admin decides penalty | A web page cannot block screenshots or second devices; honest scope agreed with user | — | ACTIVE |
| D-007 | 2026-10-16 | architecture | music | Spotify Web Playback SDK + Web API (PKCE) in admin on desktop Chrome, with a manual 'Music stopped' fallback button | User choice; Premium required; fallback keeps the game running if Spotify fails | — | ACTIVE |
| D-008 | 2026-10-16 | architecture | ai-questions | Gemini API via @google/genai from a server route only; generated questions are reviewed by the admin before saving | User has a Gemini key, not Claude; LLM output is untrusted and must be validated and reviewed | — | ACTIVE |
| D-009 | 2026-10-16 | design | visual-direction | Dark neon arcade with 3D (React Three Fiber, drei, postprocessing bloom), Framer Motion, GSAP; custom chair/trophy GLBs modelled via Blender MCP; low-power 2D fallback on player phones | User wants a modern 3D game feel; phones must stay fast during scanning | — | SUPERSEDED |
| D-010 | 2026-10-16 | product | ranking | Players who hold the last 3 chairs are the winners; podium order by correct-answer time in the final round | User: luck decides, no points system | — | SUPERSEDED |
| D-011 | 2026-10-16 | product | admin-configurable-counts | Chair count, player count, per-round chair schedule and final-round count are all set by the admin at runtime; chairs can be added/deleted/toggled any number between spins; no fixed sequence | User: the admin can add or delete anything; 10/15 and 10→8→6→4→3 were only examples | D-010 | ACTIVE |
| D-012 | 2026-10-16 | product | ranking | Players holding the chairs of the final round are the winners; podium order by correct-answer time in the final round | User: luck decides, no points system (re-records D-010, superseded by mistake) | — | ACTIVE |
| D-013 | 2026-10-16 | architecture | db-testing | Database security and RPC tests run as Vitest integration tests using supabase-js against the aimc-test cloud project (real auth users per role), instead of pgTAP | pgTAP via supabase test db needs local Docker; black-box tests through the public API exercise RLS and grants exactly as attackers would | — | ACTIVE |
| D-014 | 2026-10-16 | product | game-sessions | Games run as sessions: the admin's 'New game' ends the current session (terminating any round in progress) and opens a fresh lobby; players belong to one session and must register again for the next one; chairs and their QR codes are permanent across sessions; past sessions' results are kept | Several teams play back to back at the fest; reprinting or re-pasting QR codes between teams is impractical and error-prone | — | ACTIVE |
| D-015 | 2026-10-16 | security | player-account-creation | Player auth accounts are created server-side by the player-signup Supabase Edge Function (admin createUser, pre-confirmed, synthetic USN email); the browser then signs in with USN + PIN. The service key stays inside Supabase (auto-injected), never in Vercel or the client | Browser signUp sends a confirmation email (free tier: 2 emails/hour) and rejects the synthetic domain; server-side creation needs no email and avoids per-IP sign-up limits on shared campus WiFi | — | ACTIVE |
| D-016 | 2026-10-16 | product | who-is-playing | Registration doesn't put a player in the game; scanning a chair does. Anyone registered can play round 1 (late registrations during round 1 are active); after round 1 only its chair holders continue, later registrations are spectators. Admin sees who is in play from live scans (name, USN, chair) | User: people register freely; the real roster is whoever sits and scans in round 1 | — | ACTIVE |
| D-017 | 2026-10-17 | architecture | 3d-assets | Blender GLBs (public/models/chair.glb, podium.glb) ship uncompressed, without Draco | Low-poly models are 34 KB and 137 KB; a Draco decoder adds ~300 KB of wasm, an external decoder host and CSP 'wasm-unsafe-eval' for no real saving | — | SUPERSEDED |
| D-018 | 2026-10-17 | architecture | screen-motion | Projector sequences use motion (2D overlays) and react-three-fiber useFrame easing (3D); confetti is an instanced three.js particle burst | Both libraries are already in the bundle; GSAP and canvas-confetti would add dependencies for effects these cover | — | ACTIVE |
| D-019 | 2026-10-17 | architecture | 3d-assets | Realistic PBR models from Blender: walnut + leather chair (707 KB), lacquer/marble/gold podium with separate Trophy node (595 KB); procedural materials baked to WebP colour/roughness/normal maps; no Draco | User asked for ultra-realistic visuals; baked WebP textures keep each GLB under 1 MB, and skipping Draco avoids a wasm decoder plus CSP wasm-unsafe-eval | D-017 | ACTIVE |
| D-020 | 2026-10-17 | design | 3d-fallback | Home page, player status ring and projector always show the realistic 3D chairs; the 2D chair fallback and neon chair are removed. Slow devices drop to low quality (no mirrored floor or bloom); reduced motion stops the turning | User wants the realistic 3D everywhere and no 2D chairs | D-009 | ACTIVE |
